# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: It appears her seizure has subsided.
Forgive us. It seems we have imposed upon you.
Let me get straight to the point.
Where is this $$教団$$'s $$総本山$$, anyway?
Far above the $$バベルの塔$$,
in the $$約束の地$$ of $$ディアボロス$$, floating above the thick clouds, lies the $$総本山$$.
What the hell?!
No wonder nobody knows any of the details.
No one may enter that place without the $$教皇$$'s permission.
Yes... with one exception.
There is something I would very much like to show you.
The $$バベルの塔$$ at the center of the $$世界$$,
and the $$七つの鎖$$ that extend to Heaven.
The $$世界$$ is said to be upheld by the $$生贄$$s offered to the $$バベルの塔$$,
and by the $$七つの鎖$$ that seal the $$大邪神$$.
B-but, hey!
Five of those damned chains have already been broken, haven't they?!
Unless the seven $$封印$$s on Heaven's throne are opened,
the $$世界$$ will remain in its evil state...
But when the $$神の子羊$$ opens the $$封印$$s one by one,
calamities, death, and conflict spread across the $$世界$$...
According to the $$アンゲルス教$$ scripture called $$ハルマゲドン$$, when these chains' $$封印$$s are opened,
an unprecedented catastrophe will befall the $$世界$$.
And according to my investigation, when you...
freed that $$大邪神$$'s armor, the chains broke at almost the same time,
and ever since, massive floods, droughts, and earthquakes have begun ravaging the $$世界$$!!
Then all the massive earthquakes we've had...
are because we broke the armor's $$封印$$?!
This proves that you are the people described in the $$アンゲルス教$$ scripture—
the $$さまよえる民$$ who bring destruction and creation!!
Since you are the legendary $$さまよえる民$$,
by the $$古の盟約$$ inscribed on this $$石板$$,
even at the cost of my own life, I will lead you to the $$約束の地$$.
You must... take me with you too... no matter what...
$$ルピルピ$$!
Otherwise, I-I'll write all of your names in my $$日記$$.
